prompt: Create a vertical fine-art surreal fashion portrait of an ethereal porcelain-faced court painter leaning in from the right toward a hanging linen canvas. The figure has a smooth white mask-like face, narrow pale eyes, small muted peach lips, delicate ears, and visible cracked gold kintsugi seams across the cheek, neck, and hand. Dress the figure in translucent layered cream-white gauze robes with ruffled texture and tiny gold glitter speckles, plus a sheer veil sweeping dramatically from the head across the upper right of the frame. Add a dark traditional black headpiece or cap under the veil. The figure holds one long black calligraphy brush in one hand, touching the lower-left area of the canvas as if painting an ink landscape. The canvas on the left is tan raw linen with a black sumi-e style scene: bamboo stalks and leaves, rugged rocks, dark ink washes, and an unfinished brushy mountain-like composition. Include a small white ceramic ink vessel at the bottom left and a dark carved wooden table edge beneath it. Use a warm sepia and ivory palette, chiaroscuro lighting from the front-left, deep brown shadow background on the right, soft dust and glitter particles in the veil, hyper-detailed textures of linen, porcelain, gold cracks, sheer fabric, and wet black ink. Composition should be intimate and theatrical, 3/4 view, subject’s face in profile angled downward, elegant, haunting, museum-quality editorial photography mixed with classical East Asian ink painting aesthetics. No modern objects, no visible text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一幅竖构图的艺术超现实时尚人像，画面中 一位面容如瓷器般空灵的宫廷画师 从右侧探身靠近悬挂的亚麻画布。人物拥有光滑如面具般的白色脸庞、细长的苍白双眼、小巧柔和的桃色嘴唇、精致的耳朵，脸颊、颈部和手部可见开裂的金缮痕迹。人物身着半透明的奶油白色多层纱袍，质感褶皱并点缀着细小的金色闪粉，一条轻薄的面纱从头部戏剧性地掠过画面右上角。面纱下佩戴深色的传统黑色头饰或帽子。人物一手握着一支长长的黑色毛笔，笔尖触碰画布左下角，仿佛正在绘制一幅水墨山水画。左侧的画布为棕褐色原色亚麻布，上面绘有水墨风格的场景：竹竿与竹叶、嶙峋的岩石、浓郁的水墨渲染以及未完成的笔触山峦构图。左下角放置一个白色陶瓷墨碟，下方是深色雕花木桌边缘。采用暖棕褐色和象牙色调，左前方投射明暗对比光，右侧为深棕色阴影背景，面纱中带有柔和的尘埃和闪光颗粒，呈现亚麻、瓷器、金裂纹、轻薄织物和湿润黑墨的超精细质感。构图亲密且具有戏剧性，采用 3/4 侧面视角，人物面部侧向下方，优雅而令人难忘，融合了博物馆级的编辑摄影与古典东亚水墨画美学。无现代物品，无可见文字，无水印。
